request.query: division distributes over subtraction and strict translation order equivalence

items.name: sub_div
items.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : DivisionRing K] (a b c : K), (a - b) / c = a / c - b / c

items.name: EuclideanDomain.sub_mul_div_right
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : EuclideanDomain R] (x y z : R), y ≠ 0 → y ∣ x → (x - z * y) / y = x / y - z

items.name: tsub_div
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α]
  [inst_4 : Sub α] [OrderedSub α] (a b c : α), (a - b) / c = a / c - b / c

items.name: ENNReal.sub_div
items.type: ∀ {a b c : ENNReal}, (0 < b → b < a → c ≠ 0) → (a - b) / c = a / c - b / c

items.name: NNReal.sub_div
items.type: ∀ (a b c : NNReal), (a - b) / c = a / c - b / c
